name: webapp
description: A small web application with enough history to exercise every repository page.

milestones.description: Theming and the removal of legacy endpoints.

issues.title: Requests fail permanently after one network error
issues.body:
A single dropped connection makes the settings page show an error until it is reloaded.

### Steps

1. Open the settings page.
2. Disconnect the network for a moment.

### Expected

The request is retried.
issues.author: sam

comments.author: alex
comments.body: Reproduced. Three attempts with no delay should be enough for now.

issues.title: Add a dark mode
issues.body: The application only has a light color scheme. It should follow a toggle and remember the choice.
issues.author: alex

comments.author: sam
comments.body: A first version is up as a pull request.

issues.title: Login redirect accepts external URLs
issues.body: `?next=https://example.com` is followed after sign-in. Only local paths should be accepted.
issues.author: sam

issues.title: Document the configuration variables
issues.body: The README does not say which environment variables exist.
issues.author: sam

issues.title: Remove the legacy `/v0` endpoints
issues.body:
They have been deprecated since 1.0 and should go away with 2.0.

- [x] Announce the removal
- [ ] Delete the handlers
- [ ] Update the documentation
issues.author: alex

comments.author: alex
comments.body: Not according to the access logs of the last month.

issues.title: Settings page flickers while loading
issues.body: The page renders empty fields for a moment before the settings arrive.
issues.author: sam

pulls.title: Only follow local login redirects
pulls.body: Rejects any `next` target that does not start with `/`.
pulls.author: sam
pulls.head: fix/login-redirect

comments.body: Closing: this belongs in the changelog instead.

pulls.body:
Adds `toggleColorScheme` and the matching styles.

Still missing: remembering the choice between visits.

releases.body:
## Features

- Add a typed API client.
- Add the settings page.

## Fixes

- Retry failed API requests up to three times.
- Only follow local login redirects.

## Documentation

- Add the changelog.

**Full changelog**: `v1.1.0...v1.2.0`
